description: Starts an assist-mode run that analyses a task and writes an implementation plan for review. Writes only the run directory; changes no file and runs no command. The run then waits for plan approval: the plan must be reviewed and approved by the developer in a terminal (devflow approve <run>, or devflow reject <run> --feedback ...). Approvals stay with the developer: this tool never approves anything, and the developer approves in a terminal. In agent mode the run stops whenever DevFlow needs the model: the result then contains `agentRequest`; answer it with devflow_agent_respond. This tool starts a new run: to continue a run (for example after the developer approved), call devflow_status with its run id, never this tool again. Runs `devflow plan --json`.

cassette.description: Recorded responses for the replay provider (a file path).

issue.description: GitHub issue as the task: a number, owner/name#number or its URL (read with GITHUB_TOKEN).

maxCallsPerStep.description: Model call budget of each step.

maxInputTokens.description: Input token budget of the run.

maxOutputTokens.description: Output token budget of the run.

model.description: Model id for every step. Default: ai.models of a trusted configuration, or DEVFLOW_MODEL.

provider.description: Model provider: agent (you answer DevFlow's model requests, no API key), anthropic, openai, or replay with cassette. Default: the server's provider (agent unless `devflow mcp --provider` says otherwise).

repo.description: GitHub repository owner/name of issue (default: the origin remote).

task.description: Task file (YAML, JSON or Markdown), relative to the workspace.

workspace.description: Absolute path of the workspace (the repository root). Default: the directory the MCP server was started in.

name: devflow_plan
title: Analyse a task and write a plan (assist mode)
